source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: GetSpamFolderURI can return NS_OK for an empty target or invalid server without assigning aSpamFolderURI. The inspected current move/classification callers pass a freshly empty nsCString, so the early return represents no target there. Proposed review check for this API: preserve that initialized-output assumption or explicitly clear a reused out parameter. The source does not establish that every possible caller passes an empty string, and no stale-output failure was reproduced. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.
title: Check output initialization when a folder-URI getter returns early
